name: Revo1
summary: Revo1 is BrainCo's bionic robotic hand with six active joints and 10 total degrees of freedom. The thumb has separate flexion and abduction/adduction control, while each of the other four fingers combines an active bending axis with a passive axis. Official documentation distinguishes basic, tactile and advanced versions with different communication and sensing configurations. description.en: Revo1 is BrainCo's bionic robotic hand with six active joints and 10 total degrees of freedom. The thumb has separate flexion and abduction/adduction control, while each of the other four fingers combines an active bending axis with a passive axis. Official documentation distinguishes basic, tactile and advanced versions with different communication and sensing configurations. Position and speed control support programmable grasping, and the development resources include software examples and simulation models. Version-specific force, voltage and interface specifications should be checked against the exact hardware model.
